findings.summary: With a docs root of `.` (paths.features/archive/context at the top level), working() treats every tracked Markdown file in the project as a working doc, including dot folders. age-out --apply then git-mvs installed skills (.claude/skills, .agents/skills), Joycraft references (.joycraft/references), agent definitions (.claude/agents), .github/copilot-instructions.md and PR templates into archive/working/. Reproduced in spec-09-probes.log probe 3. Fix direction: when the docs root is `.`, skip dot folders (or anything Joycraft or a harness installs) and code folders, or limit `.` roots to top-level Markdown and non-dot folders.

A context page that names a doc as `docs/research/x.md#part`, `docs/research/x.md:12` or docs-root-relative `research/x.md` does not reach it, so the doc is listed (probe 1). Full and ../ spellings work.
findings.assumption: Map-reached means the spellings references() already reads.

findings.summary: git log --name-only lists no files for merge commits, so a doc changed today only in a merge conflict resolution is aged by its older branch commits (probe 7 lists it at 25 days). Rare; --diff-merges=first-parent would fix it.
A tracked CLAUDE.local.md under the docs root is listed as a working doc (probe 2); it is not in entryNames. Usually gitignored.

The repo's installed .joycraft/runtime/cleanup.mjs and .joycraft/references/cleanup.md differ from payload/ (last refreshed in 48c06a8); payload/PIN matches payload/ (pin-payload --check). Left to the install flow, as for other specs.
